events.name: Knoxville Jazz Orchestra: Miles @ 100 with Marquis Hill
events.info: The KJO celebrates the centennial of Miles Davis' birth with trumpeter Marquis Hill, one of the boldest visionaries of the modern era. Hill cut his teeth in Chicago before winning the Thelonious Monk Institute of Jazz competition in 2014 and becoming a presence on the global scene virtually overnight. The program will include music from across Davis' storied career, including selections from his iconic albums Miles Ahead, Sketches of Spain, and Kind of Blue.

events.info: Adapted for the stage by Jerome Hairston, based on the book by Ezra Jack Keats. The Snowy Day celebrates the magic and boundless possibilities of the first snowfall! Follow Peter and his friends as they romp and play, starting snow ball fights and making snow angels in this imaginative musical play about the childhood joys and challenges of growing up. venues.parkingDetail: To find parking information for Athletics events visit UTSpors.com. To find parking information for concerts/special events visit foodcitycenter.com
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: For all Food City Center events, accessible seating is based on availability, and options are available on Ticketmaster.

generalInfo.generalRule: Everyone regardless of age must have a ticket. All events follow a clear bag policy. All articles, including clear bags, are subject to search. NO REFUNDS/EXCHANGES. Tickets obtained outside of the box office and Ticketmaster may not be honored. For prohibited items and event day information, please visit UTSports.com or FoodCityCenter.com for full details
